description: Axe 3 (partie agents) — Prompt engineering + activation LLM : prompts structurés (occasions parsing + explanation+adjustments, un seul appel LLM par capacité), activation de LLMAgent.parse_occasion/explain_outfit avec garde provider=='none' en tête (review-F11, aucun appel réseau), enrichissement de ContextAgent (occasion_category/formality/dress_code/temperature/weather_band) en préservant les clés existantes. Non câblé dans l'orchestrateur/recommendation_agent (FEAT-005) — standalone testé. Dépend de FEAT-001 (occasions.parse_occasion_rules/weather_band/OCCASION_CATEGORIES). Backward compatible : ContextAgent.run retourne toujours occasion/weather/season + nouvelles clés.
steps: Créer backend/app/agents/prompts.py : fonctions pures (sans réseau) `occasion_parse_prompt(raw_occasion: str|None, context_hints: dict) -> list[dict]` (system : 'Tu es l'assistant stylistique DressMe. À partir du texte libre, renvoie uniquement un JSON {"occasion_category": <une des 8 catégories>, "formality": <1-5>, "dress_code": <str|null>, "notes": <str|null>}. Si incertain, choisis casual_quotidien. N'invente rien d'autre.' ; user : texte brut + indices saison/météo) et `explain_outfit_prompt(facts: dict) -> list[dict]` (system : 'Tu es l'assistant stylistique DressMe. En 1–2 phrases, explique pourquoi cette tenue convient à l'occasion/météo, en n'utilisant que les faits fournis. N'invente jamais de pièces, scores ou comptes non fournis. Si justifié, ajoute 1–2 suggestions d'ajustement concrètes avec leur raison.' ; user : facts JSON sérialisé). messages = [{'role':'system','content':...},{'role':'user','content':...}].

Modifier backend/app/agents/llm_agent.py : extraire `_chat(self, messages, *, json_mode=False, timeout=20.0) -> str` (POST {base_url}/chat/completions, headers Authorization Bearer, json incluant messages + temperature 0.7 + (response_format={'type':'json_object'} si json_mode), raise_for_status, return response.json()['choices'][0]['message']['content']). Garder `run(self, *, context, instruction) -> {'explanation': ...}` inchangé (il appelle _chat ; garde provider=='none' en tête — déjà présent). Ajouter `parse_occasion(self, raw_occasion, context_hints) -> dict|None` : PREMIÈRE ligne `if self.settings.llm_provider == 'none': return None` (review-F11, avant _chat donc aucun httpx.post) ; sinon `_chat(occasion_parse_prompt(...), json_mode=True)`, json.loads, valider occasion_category ∈ OCCASION_CATEGORIES (importer depuis app.services.occasions), formality ∈ 1..5 (int), dress_code ∈ vocabulaire du design (['tenue de cérémonie','chic','business casual','sportwear','décontracté','confortable',None]) sinon None (review-F8) ; toute erreur (HTTP non 2xx, timeout, JSON invalide, catégorie hors-vocab, formality hors range) → log WARNING + return None. Ajouter `explain_outfit(self, facts) -> str|None` : même garde provider=='none' en tête ; _chat(explain_outfit_prompt(facts)) ; erreur → WARNING + None.

Modifier backend/app/agents/context_agent.py : `__init__` accepte un `llm_agent` injecté (défaut `LLMAgent()`) pour testabilité (import LLMAgent). `run` ordre (review-F9) : (1) lookup ville si weather None et city non None → weather, temperature ; (2) `season = normalize_season(season)`; si None et temperature non None → `season_from_temperature(temperature)` ; (3) `parsed = self.llm_agent.parse_occasion(occasion, {'season': season, 'weather': weather})` si non None utiliser ses champs sinon `occasions.parse_occasion_rules(occasion)` (import depuis app.services.occasions) ; (4) ajouter au dict retourné : `temperature`, `weather_band=occasions.weather_band(temperature)`, `occasion_category`, `formality`, `dress_code`. CONSERVER les clés existantes 'occasion','weather','season' (compatibilité — review-F6).
Créer backend/tests/test_prompts.py : occasion_parse_prompt et explain_outfit_prompt retournent 2 messages (system+user) avec les rôles et contenus attendus (sans réseau).

Étendre backend/tests/test_llm_agent.py : parse_occasion/explain_outfit avec provider=none → None sans appel (httpx.post mocké en fail_if_called — assert not called) ; provider=mistral + monkeypatch httpx.post (faux JSON {'choices':[{'message':{'content':'{"occasion_category":"mariage","formality":5,"dress_code":"tenue de cérémonie","notes":null}'}}]}) → dict validé ; JSON invalide / catégorie hors-vocab / formality hors [1,5] → None (récupération). run existant reste vert (test_no_provider_returns_none_without_a_network_call inchangé).

Étendre backend/tests/test_context_agent.py : occasion libre texte → occasion_category via règles (LLM off par conftest) ; temperature/weather_band présents quand lookup réussit ; REMPLACER l'assertion exacte `result == {'occasion':...,'weather':None,'season':None}` de test_no_city_leaves_weather_none par des assertions de sous-ensemble (review-F6) : `assert result['occasion']=='wedding' and result['weather'] is None and result['season'] is None` + assertions sur les nouvelles clés (`result['occasion_category']=='mariage'`, `result['weather_band'] is None`, `result['formality']==5`). Comportements existants (météo explicite non écrasée, ville sans clé météo → None) inchangés.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_prompts.py tests/test_llm_agent.py tests/test_context_agent.py -q` passe.
LLMAgent.parse_occasion et explain_outfit retournent None SANS aucun httpx.post quand provider=='none' (test_no_provider_returns_none_without_a_network_call reste vert).
LLMAgent.run signature/retour {'explanation':...} inchangé (StyleProfileAgent dépend de lui).

ContextAgent.run conserve les clés occasion/weather/season ET ajoute occasion_category/formality/dress_code/temperature/weather_band ; test_no_city_leaves_weather_none vérifie le sous-ensemble (pas l'égalité exacte).
verification: cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_prompts.py tests/test_llm_agent.py tests/test_context_agent.py -q
cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_style_profile_agent.py -q  # run() consumer still green
findings:
FEAT-004 implemented and verified: cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_prompts.py tests/test_llm_agent.py tests/test_context_agent.py -q -> 24 passed; tests/test_style_profile_agent.py -> 3 passed (run() consumer green); full suite 208 passed / 13 skipped. The only 2 failures in the suite are pre-existing test_tryon_agent.py (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gradio_client') on the clean FEAT-003 tree — unrelated to this feature.

NEW FILE backend/app/agents/prompts.py (pure, no network): occasion_parse_prompt(raw_occasion: str|None, context_hints: dict) -> list[dict] and explain_outfit_prompt(facts: dict) -> list[dict]; each returns [{'role':'system','content':...},{'role':'user','content':...}] (system contents are the verbatim design wording). occasion_parse_prompt user = 'Occasion: <raw>\nIndices: <json.dumps(context_hints, sort_keys=True)>'; explain_outfit_prompt user = json.dumps(facts, sort_keys=True).

LLMAgent (backend/app/agents/llm_agent.py) exact signatures:
- run(self, *, context: dict, instruction: str) -> dict  # UNCHANGED, returns {'explanation': str|None}; provider=='none' guard first line; calls _chat(messages).
- _chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, json_mode: bool=False, timeout: float=20.0) -> str  # POST {base_url}/chat/completions, Bearer auth, payload {model, messages, temperature:0.7} + ('response_format':{'type':'json_object'} if json_mode), raise_for_status, return choices[0].message.content.
- parse_occasion(self, raw_occasion: str|None, context_hints: dict) -> dict|None  # FIRST line `if self.settings.llm_provider == 'none': return None` (review-F11, no httpx.post); else _chat(occasion_parse_prompt(...), json_mode=True) + json.loads; validates occasion_category in OCCASION_CATEGORIES (hard fail -> None), formality is a real int in [1,5] (bool rejected; hard fail -> None), dress_code sanitized against {'tenue de cérémonie','chic','business casual','sportwear','décontracté','confortable'} else None (review-F8, NOT a hard fail); ANY exception (HTTP/timeout/JSON/missing field) -> logger.warning + None. Returns {'occasion_category','formality','dress_code'} only (notes dropped).
- explain_outfit(self, facts: dict) -> str|None  # FIRST line provider=='none' -> None (review-F11); else _chat(explain_outfit_prompt(facts)); ANY exception -> logger.warning + None.

ContextAgent (backend/app/agents/context_agent.py):
- __init__(self, llm_agent: LLMAgent|None = None) -> None  # injected for testability; defaults to LLMAgent().
- run(self, *, occasion=None, weather=None, season=None, city=None) -> dict. Order (review-F9): (1) city lookup if weather is None and city set -> weather, temperature; (2) normalize_season then season_from_temperature if season still None; (3) parsed = self.llm_agent.parse_occasion(occasion, {'season':season,'weather':weather}); if None -> occasions.parse_occasion_rules(occasion); (4) build return dict.
- run RETURN KEYS (what FEAT-005 consumes): legacy preserved -- occasion (str|None, raw), weather (str|None), season (str|None: ete/hiver/mi_saison); NEW -- temperature (float|None), weather_band (str|None: 'froid'|'modere'|'chaud' via occasions.weather_band), occasion_category (str, always in OCCASION_CATEGORIES), formality (int 1..5), dress_code (str|None).

Notes for FEAT-005 (NOT wired here, per scope): recommendation_agent.run should gain kwargs season/temperature/weather/occasion_category/formality/references/ctx_vec (all default None; **kwargs already present); weather_band is DERIVED in run from temperature (never a kwarg, review-F1/F3); ctx_vec computed once in the orchestrator and passed to both run and context_retrieval.retrieve_references (review-F1/F13); LLM explain_outfit output must be truncated to <=2048 chars before Outfit.explanation insert (review-F7). Provider=='none' / LLM failure -> ContextAgent falls back to occasions.parse_occasion_rules (FEAT-001), RecommendationAgent falls back to the _explain template.
